args.prompt: Slow cinematic architectural drone shot, one continuous forward push. The camera glides gently forward and slightly upward, rising just enough to clear the top of the glass balcony railing, passes above the two wooden folding chairs and the small wooden table with clear headroom, and continues straight through the existing open sliding-glass doorway into the dark wood-panelled bedroom, decelerating smoothly and stopping short of the foot of the bed. Smooth stabilized gimbal move, gentle ease-in and ease-out, natural parallax, level horizon. Exposure adapts softly from bright exterior to darker interior. The real room is unchanged: dark vertical wall panels, round black mirror above the bed, dark grey bedding with white pillows and a round brass tray, grey stone tiled floor, brass pendant tubes, glass railing, chairs, table and potted plants all stay exactly in place. No people, no drone, no text.
